Conductive Ceramics

A method for integrating conductive traces into ceramic objects using silver-based glaze compatible with traditional firing processes | 2023

About

Conductive Ceramics presents a novel method for integrating conductive traces directly into ceramic objects using silver-based glaze that is compatible with traditional ceramic firing processes. This approach enables the creation of functional ceramic objects with embedded electronics, capacitive sensing, and interactive capabilities.

Method

The technique involves applying silver-based conductive glaze to ceramic surfaces before firing. The glaze integrates seamlessly with traditional ceramic materials and firing processes, allowing ceramic artists and designers to create objects with embedded electrical functionality without compromising the aesthetic or structural integrity of the ceramic piece.

Applications

This method enables a wide range of applications including capacitive sensing for touch interaction, embedded lighting, and integration with electronic systems. The conductive traces can be patterned to create custom circuits directly on ceramic surfaces, opening new possibilities for interactive ceramic art and functional objects.
